summary: Of Aiello Calabro in Calabria (1738–1797); an ancestor in the unsupported early Fiorillo pedigree; John's 7th-great-grandmother.
bio: Cecilia Fata Scaffarone was born at Aiello Calabro in Calabria on 15 February 1738 and died there on 1 February 1797. Family records attach to her an unidentified coat of arms, a silver lion on a black shield, but her place in the Fiorillo pedigree before 1800 is unsupported by records.
